introText: From thrilling theme parks to one-of-a-kind workshops, this Orlando, Florida experience is the ultimate blend of fun, learning, and unforgettable memories! Students will explore the magic of Disney Springs, spend exciting days at Disney's world-famous parks, and take part in engaging workshops designed to inspire and educate. With every moment packed with energy, excitement, and discovery, this is one Orlando adventure your students will be talking about for years to come!
